_note: Nan 2026-09-29: coverage is all of northern Thailand; we crawl CM and CR only, and accept everything that arrives on its own from anywhere in the north. 'crawl' is what the harvesters ask for; 'accept' is what the intake doors (worker, suggestions, claims, readers' pins, curated additions, geocoder) let in. The first two digits of a Thai postcode name the province. The 17 are the four-region ภาคเหนือ (9 upper north + 8 lower north).
